stages.title: Eligibility check
stages.action: Check age, education, stay/deportation history, color-vision and current notice requirements.

stages.title: Sisko P2MI online registration
stages.action: Prepare and submit the official registration using the current KP2MI guide.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK fee payment
stages.action: Verify exact amount, payee and payment code against the current notice before paying.
stages.warning: Never pay an unofficial 'job guarantee' fee.

stages.title: Fingerprint and photo capture
stages.action: Attend the assigned biometric appointment with the required originals.

stages.title: Registration document verification
stages.action: Pre-check scans and data before official verification.

stages.title: Print exam card
stages.action: Print the card after verification and check identity data.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK
stages.action: The 2026 Manufacturing EPS-TOPIK exam period ran from 4 June through 14 August 2026 at the official KP2MI test locations. The official notice states the Manufacturing minimum score was raised to 60, with ranking still controlling progression.
stages.warning: Passing stage 1 is not final selection.

stages.title: Skill + competency test
stages.action: Wait for the Manufacturing 2026 result / Skill Test notice before acting. The current verified 2026 Skill Test notice found for Fisheries must not be reused for Manufacturing.
stages.warning: As of the 6 October 2026 official-source re-check, KEP has not captured a Manufacturing 2026 Skill Test notice.

stages.title: Final point-system selection
stages.action: Do not claim final Manufacturing selection yet. KEP has not captured a current official Manufacturing 2026 result / final-selection notice in the 6 October 2026 re-check.
stages.warning: Completion of the EPS-TOPIK exam period does not prove final Point-System selection.

stages.title: Psychology examination before job application
stages.action: For 2026 graduates, complete the required psychology examination before MCU I and job application.

stages.title: Medical Check Up I
stages.action: Continue to MCU I only under the current official psychology/medical rule and approved-provider list.

stages.title: Online job application
stages.action: Do not submit using another sector's document list. Manufacturing 2026 is still waiting for its own result/next-stage and online job-application notices; follow the Manufacturing notice in Sisko P2MI only after KP2MI publishes and KEP reviews it.
stages.warning: The 19 August 2026 online job-application notice is Fisheries only. It cannot be reused for Manufacturing.

stages.title: Job-seeker roster
stages.action: Track roster status and keep phone/email active.
stages.warning: Roster inclusion does not guarantee employment.

stages.title: Korean employer selection
stages.action: Wait for employer selection through the official EPS process.
stages.warning: A private intermediary cannot officially guarantee or sell employer selection.

stages.title: Standard Labour Contract (SLC)
stages.action: Read and compare employer, pay, hours, accommodation and deductions before accepting.

stages.title: Post-SLC psychology / MCU II as required
stages.action: Follow the current cohort-specific SLC notice; complete required psychology and MCU II without delay.

stages.title: Visa document package
stages.action: Use the current checklist; verify every identity field matches before visa processing.

stages.title: Pre-employment / OPP preparation
stages.action: Complete all mandatory pre-departure and pre-employment training/checklists.

stages.title: Final health check before departure
stages.action: Follow the current departure-call notice for any required MCU-III or renewed full medical check before the flight.
stages.warning: The required final medical check depends on the validity of prior MCU results and the current departure notice.

stages.title: Departure to Korea
stages.action: Complete official departure checklist and travel on the assigned entry plan.

stages.title: Korea entry + 16-hour employment education
stages.action: After Incheon arrival, complete employment education and health re-check, then transfer to employer.

stages.title: Employer handover
stages.action: Confirm workplace, accommodation and emergency contacts before handover.

stages.title: Foreigner registration / Residence Card
stages.action: If staying in Korea for more than 90 days, complete foreigner registration with the immigration office having jurisdiction over your residence within 90 days of entry.
stages.warning: Do not wait until the deadline; workplace or residence details may be needed.

stages.title: EPS insurance check
stages.action: Confirm the required EPS insurances are enrolled by the responsible party within the applicable deadline.
stages.warning: Employer-side and worker-side insurance obligations are different; verify each policy instead of paying an intermediary.

stages.title: First payroll check
stages.authority: Employer / Ministry of Employment and Labor
stages.action: Compare the first payslip and actual bank deposit with the SLC, working hours, deductions and the applicable minimum wage.
stages.warning: For 2026 the statutory minimum wage is KRW 10,320 per hour; actual entitlement depends on hours and applicable wage rules.

stages.title: Labor problem reporting ready
stages.action: Save the official 1350 and Labor Portal routes and keep payslips, bank deposits, attendance records and contract evidence in case a wage or labor issue occurs.

stages.title: Employment and workplace-change readiness
stages.action: If a legally recognized reason for workplace change occurs, use the official EPS or employment-center process and observe the applicable deadlines.
stages.warning: Workplace change is conditional and deadline-sensitive; do not rely on an informal broker to create or guarantee a transfer.

manufacturingResult.note: No current KP2MI Manufacturing 2026 EPS-TOPIK result / next-stage notice was captured in the 2026-10-06 official-source re-check.

skillCompetency.note: The verified 2026 Skills Test notice found in current search is Fisheries-sector scoped and must not populate Manufacturing.

jobApplication.note: The 2026-08-19 online job-application notice is Fisheries-sector scoped. Manufacturing remains held until its own current official notice is published and reviewed.
